text:
maria-infra: Quick heads up — provisioning the new GPU fleet in ap-northeast-1 is hitting NLB target registration soft limits across ~12 accounts. Opening a bulk quota increase but need coordination. Account IDs: 111122223333, 444455556666, 777788889999, 222233334444. Seeing `TargetRegistrationLimitExceeded` during parallel boots, healthchecks spike 503s. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:

sam-sre: Can you paste the exact error payload/log that AWS returns? Also which quota we should request?

maria-infra: Here is the CLI error we captured during scale-up:
```
{
  "Error": {
    "Code": "TargetRegistrationLimitExceeded",
    "Message": "Cannot register more targets to target group xxxxx: limit 100 reached"
  },
  "RequestId": "abcd-1234-efgh"
}
```
We hit this while booting 180 instances concurrently in one region across multiple accounts. The quick fix was to stagger boots but we need a perm bump.

lee-cloud: For the quota ask, open requests for: `Network Load Balancer -> Target group targets` and `Targets per Network Interface` (if using IP targets). Also request higher `Target groups per load balancer` if you plan more groups.

maria-infra: Agree. I'll start a bulk request. Any preference to bundle multiple accounts into a single AWS Support case or open one per account?

anya-ops: Finance note — larger quota may induce more cross-account NLB usage which affects cost (idle LBs + per-flow charges). Can we estimate monthly delta before approving?

raj-eng: If we can reduce number of target groups (e.g., reuse TGs across similar pools) we may avoid big quota increases. But for isolation we created per-customer TGs so tradeoff there.

emma-platform: Another mitigant: spread instance boot with jitter and backoff in the autoscale lifecycle hook. That bought us time in staging. Still ok to request quota increase as long as we keep staging rollout checks. :thumbsup:

maria-infra: I'll prepare the AWS Service Quotas request. Draft payload (will attach when I open the ticket):
```
{
  "ServiceCode": "elasticloadbalancing",
  "QuotaCode": "L-ABCDEF12",
  "DesiredValue": 500,
  "AccountIds": ["111122223333","444455556666","777788889999","222233334444"],
  "Region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "Reason": "Fleet provisioning for inference GPU cluster; parallel instance registration during scale events causing TargetRegistrationLimitExceeded and transient 503s."
}
```
(QuotaCode above is a placeholder — will use exact codes from Service Quotas console.)

devops-bot: Created internal tracking ticket INFRA-7821 and AWS request AWS-REQ-987654321. Notified AWS TAM.

sam-sre: Also check `Target health check` rate — if health check fails rapidly during boot, we get thrash. Consider extending grace period on ASG health checks and using lifecycle hooks to register targets after app is healthy.

maria-infra: Good call. We will delay registration until the runtime process reports readiness (post-start hook). That reduces failed registrations and churn.

lee-cloud: FYI I've added `Interface endpoints per VPC` to the list if customers use private endpoints heavily; sometimes we hit ENI limits when we create many VPCEs.

anya-ops: OK — finance wants a 3-month projection for incremental LB costs if quota approved. Emma, can platform team run a quick cost delta sim?

emma-platform: On it — I'll run a small sim: assume average active flows per LB and extra LBs needed. Will post numbers in INFRA-7821 by EOD.

raj-eng: If AWS denies bulk increase per-account, fallback is: (1) staggered rollouts + lifecycle hooks, (2) consolidate target groups, (3) provision additional LBs and route traffic via DNS with weighted records (note: adds cost).

maria-infra: Plan: open bulk AWS quota increase for `Target registrations`, `Targets per ENI`, and `Target groups per LB`. Start with desired value 500 per quota for these accounts, attach projection and traffic pattern. I'll CC TAM and INFRA-7821.

devops-bot: AWS request updated: AWS-REQ-987654321 -> status: Pending Review. Added contact: tam@aws-partner.example.com

sam-sre: Also please add a note to the case that this is interfering with production inference fleet rollouts and reference recent incident IDs if AWS asks for impact evidence.

maria-infra: Added incident refs and pushed ticket. Will update here when AWS responds. Thanks all. :handshake:
